sources.title: Ghostty: About
sources.note: Official architecture description. Supports a native Swift/AppKit/SwiftUI host around the Ghostty C interface; does not validate this proposed app.

sources.title: Ghostty upstream repository
sources.note: Primary source and project entry point. Inspect the pinned source and licence rather than relying on a mutable main branch.

sources.title: Ghostty full embedding C header
sources.note: Inspected full surface interface, including working_directory and a command string. Header shape and ABI must be pinned together with the artifact.

sources.title: Ghostty source build instructions
sources.note: Documents release-specific Zig requirements and macOS build prerequisites. The inspected table associates Ghostty 1.3.x with Zig 0.15.2; that is a research observation, not this project's selected lock.

sources.title: Libghostty Is Coming
sources.note: Maintainer's September 2025 explanation of the separately extracted VT core. Historical explanation of the distinction, not a current package availability guarantee.

sources.title: Apple: What is new in macOS 27
sources.note: Current macOS 27 technology overview. At inspection it points to Xcode 27 and macOS 27 beta resources; validate the actual local SDK.

sources.title: Apple: App Intents
sources.note: Official framework entry point for actions and content discovery. Individual APIs require availability verification.

sources.title: Apple WWDC26: Advanced App Intents for Siri and Apple Intelligence
sources.note: Primary session on richer Siri integration, content discovery and on-screen context. Does not establish that this app has been integrated or tested.

sources.title: Apple: Adopting Liquid Glass
sources.note: Official design/technology reference. Some documentation uses JavaScript rendering; use the live documentation and installed SDK while implementing.

sources.title: Apple: GlassEffectContainer
sources.note: Official custom-glass grouping API reference. Prefer normal system controls where they already express the interaction.

sources.title: OpenAI: Codex App Server
sources.note: Official integration, protocol and account-flow reference, reached from developers.openai.com/codex/app-server. Supports version-specific schema generation; keep transport and experimental feature distinctions.

sources.title: OpenAI: Codex authentication
sources.note: Official distinction between ChatGPT sign-in and API-key access, reached from developers.openai.com/codex/auth. Does not establish a general-purpose subscription-to-API bridge.

sources.title: OpenAI: Package your plugin
sources.note: Official plugin packaging reference including skills, MCP servers and lifecycle hooks. Recheck installed-release hooks and manifest format.

sources.title: OpenCode: Plugins
sources.note: Official plugin and event reference. Supports an agent-native bridge, with actual hook behaviour to be demonstrated at the pinned version.

sources.title: OpenCode: Server
sources.note: Official backend API reference. The plan adds its own loopback, credential and lifecycle policy; documentation alone is not evidence of deployment security.

sources.title: OpenCode: CLI
sources.note: Official commands including TUI attachment to a running backend, explicit session selection and model discovery. Do not copy its network-binding examples blindly.

sources.title: OpenCode: Zen
sources.note: Official curated model-service reference. Model inventory, availability and prices are mutable and deliberately not frozen in this packet.

sources.title: OpenCode: Go
sources.note: Official subscription reference. Eligibility and catalogue must be discovered through the user's actual account.

sources.title: Pi: project site
sources.note: Primary project overview describing interactive, print/JSON, RPC and SDK modes and extensibility.

sources.title: Pi coding-agent README
sources.note: Current repository result for the coding-agent overview. Older badlogic/pi-mono links also surfaced; resolve the actual installed upstream rather than guessing package identity.

sources.title: Pi: RPC documentation
sources.note: Primary line-delimited JSON command/event and extension-UI reference. RPC is a mode owned by a particular process, not automatic observation of a different TUI.

sources.title: Pi: extension examples
sources.note: Upstream example index found during research. Exact current extension hooks must be obtained from the installed/pinned version; not treated as a frozen API.

sources.title: 1Password: SSH agent
sources.note: Official SSH-agent integration. Use normal key authorisation without exporting private key material.

sources.title: 1Password: SSH agent configuration
sources.note: Official configuration reference. Preserve user-owned configuration and distinguish use of an agent from forwarding it remotely.

sources.title: OpenSSH: ssh_config manual
sources.note: Primary configuration reference for IdentityAgent, host checks, forwarding and connection configuration. Check the local Apple-shipped OpenSSH version too.

sources.title: tmux: Getting Started
sources.note: Maintainer documentation on sessions and attachment. Persistent remote process claims still require an actual reconnect exercise.

sources.title: Andrej Karpathy: LLM Wiki idea file
sources.note: Original knowledge-base pattern and inspiration. This packet's approval, isolation and transaction design are proposed additions, not claims made by that idea file.

sources.title: Official Swift MCP SDK
sources.note: Primary Swift SDK source. Inspect the supported protocol at the pinned version and negotiate capabilities explicitly.

sources.title: MCP: SDK documentation
sources.note: Current protocol SDK overview surfaced during research. A newer documentation revision does not mean every SDK implements it.

sources.title: GRDB.swift
sources.note: Upstream Swift/SQLite toolkit. Recommended for registry, migrations and index, subject to selected-version review.

sources.title: swift-markdown
sources.note: Upstream Markdown parser and syntax-tree package. Proposed for document analysis, not a WebView-based UI.

sources.title: Yams
sources.note: Upstream YAML parser. Proposed for constrained front matter decoding rather than inventing a partial YAML parser.

sources.title: Apple: Schedule Background Activity
sources.note: Primary archived explanation of discretionary background scheduling. Useful for the scheduling model; validate actual APIs against the current SDK.
